What is Wrenqo? Wrenqo is a field service app for small home-service shops with 1 to 10 technicians — including solo operators — in every trade: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance repair, pest control, cleaning, lawn care, garage door, roofing, handyman, locksmith, pool service and more. It replaces the paper diary, the group chat, and the spreadsheet: customers book, you quote from a price book set up for your trade, your crew gets the job on their phones, and the invoice goes out the same day. Once your trial access arrives by email, setup is a few short steps on your phone — and the app keeps working in basements and on roofs with zero signal. See what Wrenqo does for your trade.

What you can do with Wrenqo

One app carries a job from the first ring to the money in your account. Here's the whole day, in order — this is what the app actually does for your shop.

Step 1 · Book

Take the call, book the job in seconds

A customer calls — or books themselves on your self-booking link. Tap + New Job, pick the customer, and the job is on the board. No paper diary, no double-booked mornings.

Every customer and past job is one search away.

See the full feature page →

Step 2 · Quote

Quote on the spot, from a ready price book

The flat-rate price book comes pre-loaded for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical work — and every other trade builds its own in minutes from its usual jobs: a pest treatment, a house clean, a lawn visit, a lock change. Pick the task, and the customer gets a clear, itemized price on their doorstep — not a guess scribbled on a card.

Upfront prices customers can see and approve.

See the full feature page →

Step 3 · Schedule & dispatch

Fill every technician's day in minutes

This dispatch app for small business puts the whole day on one screen. Assign the right technician to the right job and watch them live on GPS — no "where are you?" calls, no wasted trips.

Technician scheduling software your crew actually checks.

See the full feature page →

Step 4 · Do the job

Run the job from one card

The work order app puts everything on the job card: address, gate notes, equipment history by serial number, before-and-after photos, and voice notes when hands are busy. The technician arrives knowing the job — never blind.

Photo proof of the work, on every job.

See the full feature page →

Step 5 · Invoice

Get paid the same day

Job done? Tap Send Invoice. The customer gets a tidy, itemized invoice with a pay-now link by text or email — sent from the driveway, not from a desk at 9pm.

Same-day invoicing, while the work is fresh.

See the full feature page →

Step 6 · Follow up

Never lose money on finished work

Unbilled-work alerts flag jobs that are done but never invoiced, so finished work never quietly goes unpaid. Maintenance reminders bring customers back when their service is due — repeat work, booked on time.

The app watches your money so you don't have to.

See the full feature page →

Step 7 · Books

Keep the books straight, automatically

Invoices and customers sync two ways with QuickBooks — no typing the same job twice. And everything exports to CSV in one click whenever you want it. Your records, always yours.

No double entry between the field and the books.

See the full feature page →

Anywhere · Offline

Work anywhere — even with zero signal

Basement plant rooms, roofs, rural jobs: the full app works offline. Job cards, photos, and voice notes save on the phone and sync by themselves when signal returns.

No signal never stops a job again.

See the full feature page →

One app, every home-service trade

Wrenqo is not a 3-trade app. Every business that sends a crew to a customer's home runs the same day — book, quote, dispatch, do the work, invoice, get paid — so the same app runs all of them. Here is what it does for your trade, specifically.

HVAC

Tune-ups, no-cooling calls and installs on one board. Equipment history by serial number shows the unit's whole past before the panel opens, and maintenance reminders refill the schedule every season.

See the full HVAC page →

Plumbing

Emergencies land next to booked work without wrecking the day. Quote the water heater from the price book, photograph the install, and send the invoice before you leave the driveway.

See the full plumbing page →

Electrical

Panel upgrades, call-outs and multi-visit jobs tracked on one card. Voice notes when your hands are in the board, and full offline mode for plant rooms and new builds with no signal yet.

See the full electrical page →

Appliance repair

Fridges, washers, ovens and dishwashers — every appliance's make, model and serial lives on the customer record. Log the diagnosis, note the part ordered, and the return visit is already on the schedule.

See the full appliance repair page →

Pest control

Recurring treatments run themselves: monthly and quarterly visits book ahead automatically, routes fill by area, and every property's notes — gate codes, pets, products used — travel with the job card.

See the full pest control page →

Cleaning

Weekly, bi-weekly and one-off cleans on one calendar. Per-home checklists and access notes mean any cleaner can cover any house, photos prove the finish, and regulars get invoiced without chasing.

See the full cleaning page →

Lawn care & landscaping

Mowing routes, seasonal clean-ups and one-off projects on the same board. Recurring visits schedule themselves, crews see the whole route with live GPS, and a rained-off day reshuffles in minutes.

See the full lawn care page →

Garage door

Broken springs and opener call-outs are urgent work — the nearest tech gets the job, with live GPS. Door and opener history by home means the right parts are on the truck before you roll.

See the full garage door page →

Roofing

Inspections, repairs and full replacements as multi-day jobs on one card. Photo the roof before and after, quote from your own price list, and keep the crew's days and materials in one place.

See the full roofing page →

Handyman

A day of small jobs finally fits in one app: punch lists and per-visit task lists, priced your way — hourly or per task. Batch nearby jobs, tick tasks off on site, invoice from the van.

See the full handyman page →

Locksmith

Lockouts can't wait for paperwork. Take the call, see the nearest tech on GPS, log the job on the card, and send the pay-now link on the spot — day or night, paid before you drive off.

See the full locksmith page →

Pool service

Weekly pool routes with a visit log per pool — chemicals, cleaning and equipment checks recorded on the job card. Pump and filter history lives on the record, and recurring billing means route money never slips.

See the full pool service page →

And every other home-service trade. Painting, carpet cleaning, chimney sweep, septic service, snow removal, tree service, pressure washing, window cleaning, gutter cleaning, moving — if your crew goes to customers' homes to do the work, Wrenqo runs the day: the same booking, scheduling, dispatch, quoting, job cards, invoicing and payments, with a price book you build from your own services in minutes.

Real help, and your data stays yours

Two things should never be hard: getting a straight answer from a person, and getting your own data back. We made both easy on purpose.

Support by email, from people

Email support@wrenqo.com and a real person answers — in plain English, not ticket-system jargon. We reply within 24 hours. Setup and customer-import help is included free; you never pay extra to get started.

Your data is protected

Your customers, jobs, and invoices are encrypted when they move between your phone and Wrenqo, and we never sell your data or your customer list. Full details are in the privacy policy — written short, on purpose.

Leave anytime, take everything

One click exports all your customers, jobs, and invoices as CSV — while you're a customer, and after you cancel. Software you can leave is software that has to earn you every month. We prefer it that way.

About Wrenqo — built for the shops the big tools forgot

Simple field-service software for small home-service shops — 1 to 10 technicians, one flat price.

Why Wrenqo exists

Most field service software is built for companies with an office, a dispatcher, and an IT budget. But most home-service work is done by shops of 1 to 10 technicians — owner-operators and family crews whose office is a phone in a truck. Those shops were handed tools priced per technician, split into tiers, and loaded with features they'd never open — or they kept running the business from a paper diary and a group chat.

Wrenqo is the third option: the whole job in one phone app — booking, quoting from a flat-rate price book, scheduling and dispatch with live GPS, job cards with photos and voice notes, same-day invoicing with pay-now links, and QuickBooks sync — that keeps working with zero signal, and costs one flat $39/month for the whole shop.

Who it's for

Every home-service trade: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance repair, pest control, cleaning, lawn care and landscaping, garage door, roofing, handyman, locksmith, pool service, and any other business that sends a crew to customers' homes. Each trade has its own page showing what the app does for it.

How we work

  • One honest price. $39/month flat, monthly only — no yearly lock-in, no lifetime deals, no per-technician fees, no add-ons.
  • No lock-in, ever. No contract, cancel in 1 click, and your customers, jobs and invoices export as CSV anytime — including after you cancel.
  • Plain English. Our terms, privacy and refund policies are short on purpose, and support is a person answering email at support@wrenqo.com.
  • Honest about the roadmap. If a feature isn't in the plan yet, we say so on the homepage — we don't sell what's next as what's now.

Wrenqo is software for small home-service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance repair, pest control, cleaning, lawn care, garage door, roofing, handyman, locksmith, pool service and similar field services). It helps you schedule jobs, dispatch technicians and crews, manage customers, track equipment, and send invoices.

2. Your account

  • You must give accurate information when you sign up and keep your login details safe.
  • You are responsible for what happens under your account, including actions by your team members.
  • You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter a contract for your business.

3. Price and billing

  • Wrenqo costs $39 per month, flat. There are no per-technician charges, no setup fee, and no add-ons.
  • New customers get a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
  • Price-lock promise: your price will never rise without notice. If we ever change pricing, we will tell you before the change takes effect.
  • Payment is charged monthly after your trial ends, until you cancel.

4. Canceling

There is no contract. You can cancel anytime in 1 click from inside the app. Your access continues until the end of the paid month. Refunds are covered by our Refund Policy (10-day money-back guarantee).

5. Your data

  • Your business data (customers, jobs, invoices) belongs to you.
  • You can export it at any time as CSV, including after you cancel.

6. Fair use

Don't use Wrenqo to break the law, send spam, harm others, or try to break into the service. We may suspend an account that does — and we'll tell you why, except where the law prevents it.

7. Availability and changes

We work hard to keep Wrenqo running, but software can have downtime and bugs. We may improve or change features over time. If a change removes something important to you, you can cancel and export your data — your remedy is never a lock-in.

Wrenqo is provided "as is." To the extent the law allows, our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 3 months before the claim. Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 5, 2026 · Short and plain, like it should be.

Direct link to this page https://wrenqo.com/privacy-policy

This policy explains what information Wrenqo collects, why, and what we do with it. In short: we collect what we need to run the service, and we do not sell your data.

1. What we collect

  • Account details — your name, business name, email address, and login information.
  • Your business data — customers, jobs, schedules, invoices, equipment records, photos, and voice notes that you and your team put into Wrenqo.
  • Location data — GPS location of technicians' devices while they use the app's tracking features, so dispatch and job records work.
  • Payment details — handled by our payment processor. We do not store your full card number.
  • Basic technical data — device type, app version, and logs we need to keep the service secure and fix problems.

2. Why we use it

  • To run Wrenqo: scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, syncing with QuickBooks, and offline sync.
  • To take payment and manage your plan.
  • To support you when you email us, and to send important notices (like price or terms changes).
  • To keep the service safe and working.

3. What we never do

  • We do not sell your personal information or your business data.
  • We do not use your customer list to market Wrenqo to your customers.
  • We do not read your job photos or voice notes except to provide the service or fix a problem you report.

4. Who else sees data

Only the service providers we need to operate — for example hosting, payment processing, and (if you turn it on) QuickBooks — and only with the data they need to do their job. We may disclose information if the law requires it.

5. Your choices

  • Export everything — customers, jobs, invoices — as CSV in one click, anytime.
  • Turn GPS features off in the app; some dispatch features may then be limited.
  • Ask us to delete your account and data by emailing support@wrenqo.com. We will confirm when it's done.

6. Security

We use encryption in transit and access controls to protect your data. No system is perfect, but we treat your business data like our own.

7. Changes and contact

If this policy changes in a way that matters, we will email you first. Privacy questions: support@wrenqo.com.

Refund Policy

Last updated: November 5, 2026 · The short version: 10-day money-back guarantee, no games.

Direct link to this page https://wrenqo.com/refund-policy

Our guarantee

If Wrenqo is not right for your shop, email us within 10 days of a payment and we will refund that payment in full. No forms, no phone call, no exit interview.

How to get a refund

  • Email support@wrenqo.com from the email on your account.
  • Tell us you want a refund under the 10-day guarantee. That's all we need.
  • We process refunds back to your original payment method. Your bank may take a few business days to show it.

Free trial

The 14-day free trial needs no credit card, so there is nothing to refund during the trial. You only pay when you choose to continue after day 14.

After 10 days

Payments older than 10 days are not refundable — but there is no contract, so you can cancel in 1 click anytime and you will not be charged again. Access runs to the end of the month you already paid for.

Price mistakes

If we ever charge you the wrong amount, tell us at support@wrenqo.com and we will fix it and refund any overcharge, no matter when it happened.

Your data after a refund

A refund never traps your data. Export your customers, jobs, and invoices as CSV before canceling, or email us and we'll help you get your export.

Feedback — report a problem

Something broken, confusing, or missing? Tell us here. We read every report, and fixes and improvements ship in regular updates. The more detail you give us, the faster we can fix it. We reply within 24 hours.
